en.t: Is that so? I understand now.

units.source_text: 原来你以为女人只有在化妆的时候，才忘记肤浅的诗歌，于是才给我购买这套镜子呀。

en.t: So you thought that women forget shallow poetry only when they are putting on makeup, and that is why you bought me this mirror set.

units.source_text: 镜子既然有三面，准会让我忘个彻底，一定会忘得连我这个人，整个儿都不复存在了吧。”

en.t: Since the mirror has three sides, it will surely make me forget completely, so completely that even I myself will cease to exist altogether.
